# RetailA2Z

> Self-hosted retail point-of-sale: barcode checkout, inventory, returns, customer credit, configurable currencies and GST. A scoped REST API and MCP endpoint let an online store read SKU-linked stock and send click-and-collect orders or bills. Requires the shop to run its own instance.

## Integrate
- [External API and MCP](https://github.com/surajMsquaresoftware/POS/blob/master/docs/API.md)
- [Custom online store guide](https://github.com/surajMsquaresoftware/POS/blob/master/docs/CUSTOM_STORE.md)
